items.title: TikTok Rolls Out a Manual AI Detection Tool for Users, Officially Launches 'Likeness Detection' for Global Creators
items.excerpt: TikTok launched a public AI-content checker for users and rolled out Likeness Detection globally, letting creators and artists find and remove videos that use their likeness without consent.
items.rationale: New platform release: a global likeness-detection and takedown tool artists can use right away, plus a public AI-content checker.

items.title: SoundCloud cracks down on 'AI slop, spam, and excessive uploads' – weeks after striking AI deals with Moises and ElevenLabs
items.excerpt: SoundCloud CEO Eliah Seton's open letter updates Community Guidelines and Terms of Use to combat AI slop, spam and excessive uploads, with payout recovery among penalties, while defending the platform's new AI partnerships with Moises and ElevenLabs.
items.rationale: Concrete policy change: updated Terms and Community Guidelines with payout-recovery penalties for AI slop and mass uploads; this changes the rules for every uploader.

items.title: "They stole a decade of my life and my effort and €230,000 from my pocket": El Estepario Siberiano threatens legal action against AI scalpers
items.excerpt: Drummer El Estepario Siberiano says AI copycat accounts reskinning his videos have cost him €230,000 and is weighing legal action; he recommends creators use Atlantic's AI Watchdog tool.
items.rationale: A named artist puts a price on AI video reskinning, threatens legal action and names a detection tool creators can use.

items.title: 정부, AI 학습용 저작물 거래 기준 만든다…26일 공청회
items.excerpt: 문화체육관광부가 26일 'AI 학습을 위한 저작물 이용허락 표준계약서(안)' 공청회를 열어 AI 학습용 저작물의 범위·이용기간·이용료 산정 방식 등 거래 기준을 공개한다.
items.rationale: Official government action: Korea's draft standard licensing contract for AI training sets scope, term and fee rules that will govern music catalogs.

items.title: sonicLAB Updates SSNN With Neural Buffer FM, Expanded Network Controls
items.excerpt: sonicLAB's SSNN 2.0, an audio processor built on a live 960-neuron spiking neural network driving eight synthesis engines, adds Neural Buffer FM, more network controls and four voice outputs.
items.rationale: Instrument release (v2.0) of a spiking-neural-network synth; adds a gear/sound-design card to the set.
